question.text: Nilgiri Multi-Strategy Fund (Cat III AIF, determinate trust) sold STT-paid listed equity shares held for 18 months. Gross LTCG for the financial year is INR 10.25 lakh. Using the current rate under Section 112A and applying the INR 1.25 lakh exemption, what is the fund-level LTCG tax (ignoring surcharge and cess, pure 12.5% slab)?

explanation.text: The Logic: Taxable LTCG = INR 10,25,000 - INR 1,25,000 exemption = INR 9,00,000. LTCG tax = 9,00,000 x 12.5% = INR 1,12,500. The workbook applies the Section 112A rate of 12.5% on the gain in excess of the INR 1.25 lakh exemption. The Trap: INR 1,28,125 applies 12.5% to the full INR 10.25 lakh without applying the exemption. INR 1,02,500 uses a 10% rate post-exemption rather than the 12.5% workbook rate. INR 1,25,000 uses the wrong slab altogether. Note: The INR 1.25 lakh exemption is fund-level, so a single large LTCG realisation exhausts it for the year. Surcharge and cess would further increase the effective burden in practice.
